source.description:
Everyone's favourite porcelain throne! Design is old-school Finnish s-style toilet.
I'm slightly hesitant on publishing this since I can imagine all the skibidi edits it will be predisposed to... nevertheless **enjoy doing whatever you want with it**.

Modeled in Blender 2.79, textured in Substance. Scaled using a ruler for exact real-life measurements. **No AI**. The lid is in 3 parts with pivot points for some easy opening/closing motion. 2k pbr textures + UV map included.
